_note: FROZEN before any Layer-1 expression data were examined. Any change requires a changelog entry in PROTOCOL and a version bump.
_protocol: PROTOCOL_基质刚度与神经病理性痛.md v0.4

layer0.design: genotype x matrix stiffness x replicate

biotype_filter._added_v0_2: R2 - non-coding loci (snoRNA/pseudogene/vault RNA) reached significance through low variance at n=3 and polluted the signature

signature_definition.test: Welch two-sample t-test (stiff vs soft, within genotype)

hippo_stratification._revised_v0_2: R1 - sign-concordance requirement wrongly exiled genes whose response was COMPLETELY abolished by YAP/TAZ knockout (CTGF/CYR61/ANKRD1/AMOTL2 landed in ambiguous)
hippo_stratification.metric: delta = mean(log2FPKM+1, stiff) - mean(log2FPKM+1, soft); r = |delta_knockout| / |delta_WT|

hippo_dependent.rule: r <= 0.5 (sign irrelevant: a fully abolished response has no informative sign)

layer0._canonical_note: Minimal canonical set used only for sensitivity analysis S4. Curated from established YAP/TAZ direct-target reports; frozen a priori.

species_mapping.rule: capitalize-only when symbol is all-uppercase and matches an entry in the mouse table; otherwise leave unchanged
species_mapping.ambiguity_policy: drop conflicting symbols into _UNMAPPED list; no guess-assignment
species_mapping._v0_4_note: R7 - mapping and coverage are two different quantities and are governed separately. mapping_rate = fraction of signature members whose mouse orthologue symbol exists in the annotation (expression-filter independent): a MAPPING FAILURE. coverage_rate = fraction of signature members detected in the target expression matrix after its detection filter: a POWER / cell-type limitation. Only a mapping_rate breach downgrades a primary endpoint; a coverage shortfall is declared in Limitations.
species_mapping.declare_if_coverage_below: power limitation stated in Limitations; effect estimate not interpreted

multiplicity.family: 16 base tests (4 tissues x 2 models x 2 directions) per signature family

overlap_test.method: Fisher exact test on 2x2 table (signature membership x author DEG)

floor_limited.action: flagged in gene-level table; retained in module rank test; removed in sensitivity S2

positive_control._added_v0_4: R9 - a pipeline that only ever yields null results cannot distinguish 'no signal' from 'cannot detect signal'. A pre-specified positive control establishes sensitivity.
positive_control._selection_basis: Regeneration-associated genes (RAGs) and nerve-injury markers consistently reported as up-regulated in DRG neurons after peripheral nerve injury (SNI / axotomy). Selected from the literature ONLY - never from any expression result of this project, which would be circular.
positive_control._direction: expected UP in SNI relative to sham

pass_criterion.statistic: exact permutation P on the saline-arm SNI-vs-sham score difference
pass_criterion.also_report: effect size (difference / pooled SD) for magnitude comparison against the stiffness signatures

positive_control.on_failure: All null conclusions are void. Do not report results from this pipeline; register the diagnosis in protocol v0.5 and declare the unvalidated sensitivity in Limitations.

sensitivity_analyses.S3: rank by log2_fcZ instead of log2_fc
sensitivity_analyses.S5: include ambiguous members in HD set
